judgment.rationale: Both are BASIC 3 Indicators (same grain, same rank 2) under Strand 2: Reading, but in different sub-strands: B3.2.3.1.2 'Use words containing digraphs to make meaningful sentences' (Word Families, Rhyming Endings and Common Digraphs, under B3.2.3.1 on rhyming endings/digraphs for comprehension) and B3.2.2.1.3 'Use basic elements of structural analysis (prefixes, suffixes, compound, root words) to decode unknown words' (Phonics, under B3.2.2.1 on connecting sounds to letters).
